name: approve-tool-calls
title: Approve a turn's tool calls, as plain states

comparison.purpose: Approval is a waiting state, three events a person sends, and approve-always rules kept in context. Calls run in proposal order, a rule matches only the same tool and arguments, and canReach proves that nothing runs without a rule or a person's approval.

starters.label: A read covered by a rule, then a write
